description:
FILED s473t3 (Opus triage of the 79 CATALOG-only blessed rows), on main
d9a2aac0.  PRE-EXISTING.  Probe: scratch/s473t3/probes/p21-misc.pl.

ROWS BEHIND IT (baselines/fail-baseline.tsv, 3 rows):
  split.t 149 `assignment to split-to-array (pmtarget/pmreplroot)`
  split.t 150 `assignment to split-to-array (targ/lexical)`
  split.t 151 `assignment to split-to-array (stacked)`

REPRODUCER (perl 5.40.3 vs ./runpcl):
    my @a;  (@a       = split //, "abc") = 1..10;  print "149=[@a]\n";
    our @b; (local @b = split //, "abc") = 1..10;  print "150=[@b]\n";
    my @c;  (@{\@c}   = split //, "abc") = 1..10;  print "151=[@c]\n";
  perl: 149=[1 2 3]  150=[1 2 3]  151=[1 2 3]
  PCL : 149=[a b c]  150=[a b c]  151=[a b c]

MECHANISM (perlop, "Assignment Operators"): a list assignment used as an
LVALUE yields the list of element SLOTS it just assigned -- here 3 of them,
because the inner RHS produced 3 elements.  The outer `= 1..10` therefore
fills exactly those 3 and discards the rest.  PCL evaluates the inner
assignment for its VALUE and the outer assignment writes nowhere, so `@a`
keeps the split result and no error is raised.

CATALOG NOTE THIS REPLACES: sweep-bug-catalog.md split.t, "Chained
list-assignment-as-lvalue (tests 149-151) - catalog mislabeled these
'package-qualified array'; they are not."  (That correction stands; this task
carries the reproducer and the three row keys.)

FAMILY: lvalue semantics; adjacent to #1452 (list assignment does not resolve
its LHS lvalues first).
subject: BUG (list assignment as an lvalue): `(@a = split //, "abc") = 1..10` fills only the inner assignment's N slots in perl (`1 2 3`); PCL treats the inner result as a whole-array lvalue and the outer assignment is a no-op (`a b c`)
